_readme: The 5 index underlyings tracked for F&O (futures + options) via the GapFill checkpoint. Verbatim data moved from curatedUnderlyings.json's 'indices' array -- nothing reshaped, nothing recomputed. Edit this file directly to add/remove/adjust an index; curatedUnderlyingsLoader.js reads it as-is.

indices.notes: Only NSE index with a live weekly cycle (SEBI Oct-2024 circular limits each exchange to one weekly-expiry benchmark; NSE picked NIFTY). Spot symbol confirmed via INDEX_ROOT_TO_SYMBOL in server.js. Expiry day rule confirmed via NSE circular 111/2025 (effective 1-Sep-2025).
Weekly discontinued Nov 2024 per SEBI's one-weekly-per-exchange rule. Spot symbol confirmed via INDEX_ROOT_TO_SYMBOL in server.js.
